Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished realistic desktop website UI design reference for ROKABA (ROHIS Kabupaten Banyumas), front-on orthographic, high resolution, landscape 3:2. This is a website screenshot, NOT a physical monitor or angled floating presentation. Reference 1 is the liquid glass material: thick transparent rounded lenses, visible refracted double edge, softly magnified and blurred BACKGROUND through the glass, small clear highlights, subtle green tint. Reference 2 is the neumorphic sculptural depth: physically coherent raised soft porcelain cards, strong but soft lower-right cast shadows, white upper-left bevels, inset channels. Adapt both to warm alabaster #F7F5F0, sage, deep pine #103C2E, small antique brass accents; NOT rainbow/pastel dashboard colors. Reference 3 is the existing news carousel whose exact three-card arrangement must be retained: large raised active center card in front, smaller partially overlapped left/right cards behind, arrows at outer sides. Reference 4 is the ORIGINAL real organization photograph; reuse it as faithfully as possible, no invented people, no replacing with stock photo. Side news photographs may be reused from reference 3. Professional editorial restraint, very clear Plus Jakarta Sans-like typography, minimal consistent outline icons, precise alignment, generous deliberate spacing. IMPORTANT glass and neumorphism must look like distinctly different materials: airy transparent glass nav, chips and controls; tactile ivory porcelain text cards. Consistent daylight top-left; short contact shadow plus broad ambient shadow reveal thickness. Text remains dark, crisp, unwarped, high contrast. Optical effects only on background/edges. Avoid bubbly toy aesthetics, chrome, neon, excessive gold, sparkle icons, floating spheres, illegible paragraphs, exaggerated perspective. Background has soft daylight green foliage shadow at outer margins with quiet faint warm/sage color fields.
OUTPUT A: complete redesigned desktop home overview. Top wide capsule liquid-glass navigation bar with ROKABA wordmark left, compact links "Tentang", "Program", "Berita", "Agenda", and pine glass button "Hubungi kami". Right large real group photograph from image4 in inset ivory frame, with thick transparent glass caption lens overlapping bottom "Bertumbuh bersama"; visibly magnify foliage/photo underneath the lens and refract edges without blurring text. Under hero a row of 3 raised porcelain service tiles with small glass outline icon mounts, labels "Program & kegiatan", "Sekolah anggota", "Tanya jawab". Bottom half: heading "Kabar ROKABA", right link "Semua berita", the exact THREE CARD coverflow pattern from image3, now beautifully tactile: central card dominant, photo at top, modest transparent tag "Organisasi", title "Musyawarah Kerja Daerah ROKABA", metadata "25 September 2026 · Humas ROKABA", full-width raised pine button "Baca selengkapnya". Two sidecards behind with source photos and titles "Workshop desain dakwah" and "Silaturahmi pelajar". Keep central entire card visible and all content within canvas with generous outer margins. No UI annotations. Small understated bottom caption outside content "Konsep visual · Beranda PC".
